title: Seeing the Unseen: How EMoE Unveils Bias in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring epistemic uncertainty and image quality (via CLIP scores) of text-to-image models when prompted in 25 different languages, comparing performance on high-resource languages like English against underrepresented languages like Finnish.
Evaluating disparities in epistemic uncertainty and generated image quality by comparing the model's performance on prompts translated into European languages versus non-European languages.
